title: Donald Trump versus the ICC
gist: Crawshaw argues the ICC faces existential peril after member states voted 82-13 to remove prosecutor Karim Khan over alleged misconduct, while the Trump administration escalates sanctions and threatens to cut the court off from financial services, and five states (Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Venezuela, Chad) plan to exit. He contends the court's ambition is growing and its warrants still bite (Duterte trial, Putin's curtailed travel), but European founders are failing to defend it.
